metadata.scope: Two-piece snap-fit and screw-lid electronics enclosures, DIN rail boxes, PCB trays.

material_suggestions.notes: Good layer adhesion; printable with tight tolerances; up to 70 °C.
Can warp; use enclosure printer. Good impact resistance.
Chemical resistance; moisture uptake causes dimensional change.
Lightweight; anodise for appearance and corrosion protection.

standards_used.name: IP54 / IEC 60529
standards_used.applies_to: dust and splash protection for electronics boxes
standards_used.note: IP54 = dust-protected + splash-resistant; requires sealed lid and cable glands.

standards_used.name: DIN rail TS35
standards_used.note: 35 mm rail width; 7.5 mm rail height for standard TS35.

standards_used.name: PCB mounting (Raspberry Pi 4)
standards_used.note: Pi 4: 85×56 mm, 4× holes on 58×49 mm pattern, ø2.75 mm.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Two-piece electronics enclosure with screw lid

fit_guidance_mm.standoff_hole: M3 self-tap at 2.8 mm or heat-insert at 4.2 mm

main_features: hollow shell (outer box minus inner cavity)
design_rules: shell = difference of outer cube minus inner cube
inner cavity offset by wall_thickness in X/Y and bottom_wall in Z
standoffs are cylinders added in union with pilot holes subtracted
lid lip = outer dims minus 2×gap on each side
validation_criteria: inner cavity subtracted from outer shell
lid lip present as smaller cube inside lid
failure_modes: solid block instead of hollow shell
missing standoffs — no way to mount lid
lid lip wrong size — does not fit

constraint_checks.message: Enclosure must be hollow: outer cube minus inner cavity.
Enclosure should have screw boss standoffs.
